description: This file provides shared utility functions for mapping statuses or strings to deterministic or theme-based colors, specifically used in the context of a dashboard with dark themes. It defines functions `colorFromString` to generate pastel HSL colors from strings, and `getStatusColor` to map known statuses to theme colors or fallback to deterministic colors.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel HSL color based on the input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a specific color based on theme tokens, with fallbacks to deterministic color generation.
